prompt: Rendered in a pencil sketch with light color wash, the interior of a fire station bustles with quiet activity. On the left stands a tall firefighter in yellow gear, holding a coiled hose loosely at his side. Next to him, near the center, sits a dalmatian with black spots, its head tilted curiously upward. The dog is looking at the firefighter, creating a gentle bond between man and beast. In the center background, a large red fire truck dominates the space, its chrome bumper gleaming faintly under the sketched shadows. To the right of the truck, an older mechanic in blue overalls leans against the tire, wiping grease from his hands with a rag. He is pointing at the engine block, explaining something to the young recruit beside him. This recruit, wearing a crisp white shirt, listens intently while holding a clipboard tight against his chest. In the foreground on the far right, a wooden bench holds a forgotten helmet, resting alone. The firefighter in yellow gear is standing next to the dalmatian, anchoring the left side of the composition. The mechanic in blue overalls is interacting with the recruit by pointing, drawing attention to the mechanical details. There is no visible flame or smoke in the scene, keeping the atmosphere calm and preparatory rather than chaotic. The lines are soft yet distinct, capturing the texture of the rubber hose and the fabric of the uniforms without heavy shading. The color wash adds subtle warmth to the red truck and the yellow gear, contrasting with the cool blues of the mechanic's attire and the neutral tones of the station walls.
